section-thresh.title: Alert thresholds (like the Connect IQ app)

location-1-name.tooltip: Display name for the primary forecast point (panel chip shows this point).

location-1-coords.tooltip: Paste straight from Google Maps: 52.387520877358256, 4.7199631014777 — or type lat, lon with dot decimals.

location-2-name.tooltip: Empty coordinates = disabled. Extra commute stop.

location-2-coords.tooltip: Paste from Google Maps: lat, lon. Leave empty to disable.

location-3-coords.tooltip: Paste from Google Maps: lat, lon. Leave empty to disable.

location-4-coords.tooltip: Paste from Google Maps: lat, lon. Leave empty to disable.

location-5-coords.tooltip: Paste from Google Maps: lat, lon. Leave empty to disable.

refresh-minutes.tooltip: How often to fetch Open-Meteo data (minutes, minimum 5).

startup-delay-sec.tooltip: The first fetch happens right away; this schedules one extra fetch N seconds after startup (covers login before the network is up). 0 = no extra fetch.

forecast-hours.tooltip: How many coming forecast hours (risk + precipitation) to list in the popup and graph. 12 covers the ride home after work; 24/48 cover the coming days hour-by-hour. The Open-Meteo fetch window follows this (plus the daily overview below, capped at 14 days / 336h).

forecast-days.tooltip: Per location, one summary row per coming calendar day (0 = off). Each day aggregates the same hourly risk engine: peak risk, rain/snow totals, ice hours, peak gust and temperature low. The fetch window is extended automatically (days x 24h) up to 14 days / 336h.

units.tooltip: Metric: °C, km/h, mm/cm. Imperial: °F, mph, inches. Only labels convert — the risk engine and the alert thresholds below stay metric.

show-temperature.description: Show air temperature next to the risk label

color-mode.tooltip: bright = vivid risk colors; modest = muted risk colors. Applies to the panel chip and the location name + risk rows in the popup. Combine with the minimum-risk setting below (Never = theme decides).

color-min-level.description: Show colors only when risk is above
color-min-level.tooltip: Chip and popup location rows stay uncolored (panel theme decides) below this risk level. Never = no background colors at all (replaces the old Follow theme option).

use-hsp-text.description: Auto text color via HSP luminance
use-hsp-text.tooltip: When on, chip and popup risk-row text is black/white chosen by HSP brightness of the background. When off, use fixed black-on-yellow/orange, white-on-red.

hsp-threshold.tooltip: HSP 0 = black, 255 = white. Backgrounds brighter than this get black text.

show-best-hour.description: Show calmest departure hour per location
show-best-hour.tooltip: One row per location naming the calmest hour to ride in the coming forecast window (lowest risk, then lowest gust).

show-peak-risk.description: Show peak risk of coming hours on panel
show-peak-risk.tooltip: When on, the panel chip shows the highest risk level over the coming forecast hours instead of the current risk (uses the Coming hours count above, not the daily overview).

graph-daynight.description: Shade night hours in the graph
graph-daynight.tooltip: When on, night hour columns get a slightly different background so day and night are easy to tell apart. Colors below.

graph-day-bg.tooltip: Background color for day hour columns in the hourly graph image.

graph-night-bg.tooltip: Background color for night hour columns in the hourly graph image (only when shading above is on).

graph-colors-reset.tooltip: When ON, the graph day/night backgrounds reset to defaults (#111111 / #1e2733) on the next refresh, then this switches itself back OFF automatically (one-shot).

graph-values.tooltip: All hours: every hour gets its wind + precipitation numbers. Peak hour only: only the strongest wind hour and the wettest rain/snow hours are labeled. None: curves and columns without per-hour numbers (axis scales stay).

panel-chip-locations.tooltip: Primary only = chip shows location 1 plus the first other location reaching the alert level below (each with its own risk background, calm part stays plain, e.g. H Ok|I Crt). All points = chip shows location 1 plus the highest-risk point. Hovering the chip lists details for points reaching 'Show colors only when risk is above'.

panel-chip-alert-level.tooltip: In 'Primary + first alert' mode, the first other location at or above this risk level is appended next to location 1.

thresh-ice-alert.tooltip: Big ICE warning when surface temperature is at/below this (like the Connect IQ app threshIceAlert, default 3.0°C).

thresh-cross-gust.tooltip: Mirrors Connect IQ threshCrossGust (moderate crosswind alert).

thresh-headwind.tooltip: Mirrors Connect IQ threshHeadwind (magnitude; alert when headwind component reaches this).

thresh-precip-ahead.tooltip: Mirrors Connect IQ threshPrecipAhead: forecast rain/showers at/above this flag a RAIN/SHOWERS AHEAD alert.
